overview_description.description: Shelf Drilling is an offshore drilling company exclusively focused on providing shallow water services to the oil and gas industry. The company deploys fit‑for‑purpose rigs—primarily independent‑leg cantilever jack‑up units—to support well completion, maintenance, and decommissioning work for clients including national and integrated oil and gas operators in regions such as the Middle East, Southeast Asia, India, West Africa, and the Mediterranean.
